from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    observed = {i: row[0] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row)}
    for period in range(1, n + 1):
        pattern = {}
        valid = True
        for i, color in observed.items():
            r = i % period
            if r in pattern and pattern[r] != color:
                valid = False
                break
            pattern[r] = color
        if valid and len(pattern) == period:
            return [[pattern[i % period]] * len(grid[0]) for i in range(n)]
    raise ValueError("No fully specified repeating row pattern found")
'''
